userPermDenialCacheKey concatenates action, name, and parent using underscore delimiter, which can cause key collisions if any component contains underscore (e.g., name="a_b", parent="c" vs name="a", parent="b_c"), potentially applying cached denial to wrong resource pair

Test comment claims permissions cache is set to "allow" to prove denial cache short-circuits, but the inserted map value is false (equivalent to no grant), so it doesn't actually verify that a would-be allow from permCache gets overridden by the denial cache
